populate_render_tab: populate a Viser GUI tab with camera keyframe controls, playback, and render command generation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
create_Keyframe_from_camera: create a Keyframe dataclass from a Viser CameraHandle capturing position, orientation, FOV, and model transforms
update_Keyframe_model_poses: update a Keyframe's model sizes and poses from current slider and transform control values
add_camera_to_CameraPath: add or replace a camera keyframe in a CameraPath with Kochanek-Bartels spline interpolation support
interpolate_CameraPath_pose_and_fov: interpolate camera pose, FOV, and model transforms at a normalized time along the CameraPath spline
